plan: A hunter who leaps out of bushes and turns invisible to swoop onto his prey.
aSurveiller: His R (Thrill of the Hunt). He turns invisible and leaps onto you: an eye appears above your head when he targets you.
contrer: When an eye appears above you, regroup with your allies.
Don't stay near bushes: he leaps out of them.
Buy a control ward: it reveals his R.
faiblesses: Weak if you wait for him grouped.

sorts.P: Leaps out of bushes; builds ferocity.
sorts.R: Turns invisible and hunts a champion.

momentFort: Very dangerous from level 3 out of bushes, even more at level 6. If he fails early, he struggles to come back.
